parties.petitioner: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India

summary: Jurisdictional challenge to proceedings under Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code; validity of complaint filed under Section 236 read with Sections 190, 193, 200 Cr.P.C; prosecution for Sections 73(a) and 235A violations; Companies Act amendment impact on Special Courts jurisdiction; whether Companies (Amendment) Act, 2017 restricts Special Court jurisdiction to Companies Act offences only; legislative intent regarding incorporation versus reference; complete code doctrine; jurisdictional error in quashing complaint.
legal_provisions_cited: Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 s.236, s.73(a), s.235A
Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 s.190, s.193, s.200
final_judgment: Case remanded to High Court to reconsider submissions not previously addressed regarding jurisdictional competence of Special Court.
